Business plan:

Growers Best Organics Nursery and Worm Farm:

Growers Best Organics Nursery and Worm Farm specializes in selling high-quality, organic compost, and living soil to farmers and homeowners in the local area. They also sell red wigglers and other products for gardening.

Key strengths:

  1. Quality products: The company takes pride in producing high-quality organic compost and living soil made from locally sourced ingredients.
  2. Expertise: The company has a team of experienced professionals who understand the science of organic composting and soil preparation.
  3. Sustainable practices: The company is committed to sustainability and uses eco-friendly processes to produce its products.

Marketing efforts will be focused on building relationships with local farmers, landscaping companies, and homeowners who are interested in sustainable gardening practices. The company will also focus on creating a strong online presence, including a website and social media accounts.

Country Farm Services:

Country Farm Services specializes in providing farm animal services, including manure hauling, and farm animal care for small to large farms. The company offers wheelbarrow-friendly dumpsters and bulk haul-off services to meet clients' specific needs.

Key strengths:

  1. Expertise: The company has a team of experienced professionals who are knowledgeable in providing farm animal services.
  2. Quality service: The company is committed to offering high-quality services that meet the individual needs of each client.
  3. Flexibility: The company offers flexible hauling service options, including monthly accounts, to meet clients' needs.

Marketing efforts will be focused on building relationships with local farmers who are interested in high-quality farm animal services. The company will also focus on creating a strong online presence, including a website and social media accounts.

Green Thumbs Recycling:

Green Thumbs Recycling is a business that accepts green waste and animal farm waste from Country Farm Services. The business also offers a food scrap recycling program for residential homes and provides free compost in return. The company is focused on sustainability and keeping waste out of landfills.

Key strengths:

  1. Sustainable practices: The company is committed to sustainability and uses eco-friendly processes to recycle waste materials.
  2. Community involvement: The food scrap program encourages community involvement in sustainable practices.
  3. Partnerships: The company's partnership with Growers Best Organics Nursery and Worm Farm provides a reliable source of compost materials.

Marketing efforts will be focused on building relationships with local residents who are interested in reducing their carbon footprint and promoting sustainable practices. The company will also focus on creating a strong online presence, including a website and social media accounts.

Overall Business Plan:

These three businesses will work together to offer a comprehensive range of farm and gardening services for clients. Country Farm Services will provide care and hauling services for farm animals and their waste products. Green Thumbs Recycling will recycle green waste, farm animal waste, and food scraps, and Growers Best Organics Nursery and Worm Farm will use these recycled materials to create high-quality, organic compost and living soil. This partnership creates a complete system of sustainable farming practices.

Marketing efforts will be focused on building relationships with local farmers, landscaping companies, and homeowners interested in sustainable gardening practices and responsible waste disposal.

Pay scale & monthly schedule

Growers Best Organics, Country Farm Services and Green Thumbs Recycling:

Salesperson:

  • $10 per cubic yard sold of compost and or soils or possibly 10% of total

Salesperson:

  • One-time sign-on bonus of 50% of the first service charge for any new farm service accounts or Green Thumbs Recycling accounts
  • 5% recurring commission for each time the customer is charged on that account

Driver:

  • 25% of the total charged to the customer for any driving positions
